The '''Firearc49 Speargun''' was a model of [[blaster speargun]] manufactured by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] and marketed to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as an underwater assault weapon. The weapon was a long metal pipe capable of shooting small spears underwater to a distance as far as fifty [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. A small [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] was located beneath the spear [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]]. The speargun held one spear at a time, with room for two more to be clipped on the side. The blaster's ammunition pack lasted fifty shots. A quiver could be carried by the wielder to carry additional spears. The [[Aquatic assault stormtrooper|seatrooper]] garrison on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Spira/Legends|Spira]] was equipped with this model of weapon.<ref name="TSR" />

The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[War'qi]] was known to use the Firearc49 when hunting [[Ghest/Legends|Ghests]] in the swamps of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]].
